habitat: Forest and scrub in hilly country; mid- to upper canopy of tropical evergreen and moist deciduous forest, forest edges; often joins mixed-species foraging flocks; sea level to 2400 m
description: Small black-and-white canopy bird (male glossy black above, female brown above, both with white wing bars, white tail edges and rump) that hunts insects by flycatching and gleaning in mid-canopy, often with mixed flocks.
